piano_mode_help.message: Play the selected loop with your keyboard, using physical QWERTY key positions. At octave 0, Q and comma play C5 (the original sample); Z plays C4. The Z and Q rows play white notes; the A and number rows add sharps. Every mapped key sounds: the gaps repeat nearby notes. Semicolon, quote, brackets, comma, period, slash, minus and equals are included. ← lowers one octave; → raises one (range −4 to +3). The number in the message shows the octave shift. Higher notes play faster and shorter; lower notes play slower and longer. Cut itself stops earlier notes; turn it off to layer notes. With ADSR on, releasing a key starts the release. With ADSR off, samples keep playing after keyup until they end or Cut itself stops them. After preparation, move the loop boundaries to edit the sample live. Escape exits; entering again resets the octave. The track stays paused. Typing in text fields and Ctrl/Cmd/Alt shortcuts remain available.

help_getting_started.message: Open a track, playlist, Likes, or a user's Tracks page. Use the Download button here or the download button on the SoundCloud page.

help_collection.message: For playlists, Likes, and user tracks, enter an amount, choose All, or use Select for individual tracks. Downloads keep running if you close this popup.

help_folder.message: Use the folder button to choose where files are saved. Use × to return to the browser Downloads folder.

help_format.message: Auto selects the available stream. Original is available only when the artist has enabled an original download. Source quality varies by track.

help_progress.message: The status shows progress and saved files. If a track cannot be read or saved, retry after reloading SoundCloud or choosing the folder again.

help_looper.message: Looper follows the track in SoundCloud's persistent player, even when you navigate or close the control panel. Set A/B from the panel or edit the same range on a compatible waveform; WAV export remains beside the waveform.

help_speed_intro.message: The speed selector controls SoundCloud playback from 0.1x to 3x and shows the active speed beside the player controls.

help_speed_open.message: Press the speedometer in the player controls. Use the white download icon inside the panel to download the entire current track at the effective speed and Keep Tone setting. The orange WAV button exports only the selected A-B range.

help_speed_presets.message: Choose one of the four quick speeds. The two X buttons are custom presets: hold one to save the slider's current speed, then click it to restore that exact value. Custom presets stay saved between SoundCloud sessions.

help_speed_slider.message: Drag the slider anywhere from 0.1x to 3x in 0.025x steps. Double-click the slider to return to the normal 1x speed.

help_speed_pitch.message: Enable Keep Tone to change duration while keeping the original musical pitch. Leave it off to let pitch rise or fall with speed. The option is disabled when the browser cannot preserve pitch.

help_speed_bypass.message: The single bypass icon temporarily disables the loop and plays at 1x without losing the selected range, speed, or Keep Tone setting. The logo turns gray while bypass is active; press it again to restore everything.

help_speed_memory.message: Your selected speed and Keep Tone choice are stored locally, restored on later visits, and applied to the current player and newly loaded SoundCloud audio.

help_speed_looper_effect.message: Full-track downloads from the white panel button and A-B WAV exports use the effective speed. Keep Tone preserves pitch; with it off, duration and pitch change. Bypass exports at the normal 1x rate.

help_speed_close.message: Click outside the panel or press Escape to close it. If playback or saving a preference fails, the panel shows a message; reload SoundCloud and try again.

looper_intro.message: Try Player Tools for 7 days with up to 20 new A–B loops, all FX, EQ, Likes Explorer and sampler loop/piano features. Reverb and Echo stay free. WAV and processed exports require Pro.

looper_step_open.message: Open the SoundCloud track you want to work with, then wait for it to load or start playing it.

looper_step_enable.message: Open the speedometer panel and use Set A and Set B at the live playhead, drag either handle on the Loop slider, or press the loop button before More actions on a compatible waveform.

looper_step_range.message: The panel and waveform edit the same A–B range in real time. The panel shows milliseconds for short tracks and hours when needed; waveform arrow keys move a marker 100 ms, or 1 second with Shift.

looper_step_zoom.message: Scroll up over the waveform to zoom toward the cursor, then scroll down to zoom back out. It makes small A–B adjustments much easier.

looper_step_save.message: Choose Download loop to save the A–B range as a WAV file.

looper_tip.message: The loop is temporary and follows the current player track across SoundCloud navigation. Changing the playing track removes it. The shared bypass pauses both loop and playback effects without forgetting their settings.
